warmIvory.notes: Approved palette value. Do not infer that it passes every text-contrast use.

warmGray.notes: Approved palette value. Contrast on Warm Ivory is insufficient for normal-sized text under WCAG AA.

mutedTeal.notes: Approved palette value. Contrast on Warm Ivory is insufficient for normal-sized text under WCAG AA.

darkBrown.notes: Approved palette value; preferred dark neutral reference.

warmOrange.notes: Approved palette value. Contrast on Warm Ivory is insufficient for normal-sized text under WCAG AA.

motionBackground.source: Motion direction proposed during DN-MOTION-001 planning
motionBackground.notes: Candidate use of Dark Brown instead of pure black; not a separate approved semantic token.

latinUi.notes: Not finally approved; font file, exact version, license, loading, and rendering must be verified.

arabicUi.notes: Not finally approved; Arabic shaping and RTL behavior must be tested in the actual video render pipeline.

code.notes: Not finally approved; verify version and license before distribution.

arabicWordmark.notes: The final wordmark font has not been selected or verified; do not treat this fallback list as a decision.

tagline.notes: Approved wording; motion treatment remains a candidate until visual QA.

arabicName.notes: Approved wording; rendered shaping and lockup layout remain subject to QA.

logoGeometry.notes: Previously documented as a geometric reconstruction; original visual reference was absent. Not certified as final master geometry.

frameRate.notes: Target frame rate for the initial pilot.

durationSeconds.notes: Target duration for the initial pilot.

pixelCount.notes: Must be reconciled with verified symbol geometry before implementation.

easing.notes: Preferred easing; linear and bounce easing are excluded from the proposed motion language.

sloganInitialScale.notes: Initial scale for each slogan word.

sloganFinalScale.notes: Final scale for each slogan word.

arabicEnglishTransition.notes: Prefer crossfade over glyph morphing to protect Arabic shaping; validate the actual renderer.
